$comment: The app's resource budgets: the single source of truth (docs/BUDGETS.md explains each one; tools/check_budgets.sh measures them). Raise a limit only with the owner's OK, in the same commit as the reason in docs/BUDGETS.md.

idleFrames.what: frames drawn per second, window shown and focused, nothing changing, per page

shownCpu.what: CPU of the main, renderer and utility processes, window shown and idle, per page (the GPU process is reported, not judged: software rendering on the test display inflates it)

hiddenCpu.what: CPU of every app process together, window hidden in the tray

memory.what: proportional set size of every app process together, 10 minutes after start (--quick: at the end of its run)

growth.what: memory trend over the soak after warm-up (least-squares slope), --long only
